Why families choose us

Learning that fits your home, your language, your life

Everything is built around one idea: a student learns best when the teacher is truly theirs.

  • ◉
    One-to-one, every timeA separate, dedicated teacher for each student — never a crowded class.
  • ♀
    Female teachers for women & girlsExperienced male and female teachers, so every learner can learn comfortably.
  • ◷
    Flexible timingsClass times arranged around your routine and your time zone.
  • ⌂
    From anywhere in the worldLearn from home — from any country, with no travel and no waiting.
  • ✦
    Tajweed from the startCorrect recitation is taught from the very first lesson, for beginners and advanced students alike.
  • ✓
    Completely free trial classExperience a real class before admission — with no obligation.
How it works

Three simple steps to your first lesson

  1. Book your free trialMessage us on WhatsApp and tell us who will learn and which course interests you.
  2. Meet your teacherWe match you with a teacher and agree a time that suits your day and your time zone.
  3. Learn, one-to-oneTake your trial class from home. If you love it, enrol — and keep learning with the same teacher.

For families living abroad

Far from home. Close to the Qur'an.

For families living abroad — learning from home, wherever you live.

Many of the institute's students learn from outside Bangladesh — families have enrolled from the United Kingdom, France and Italy, and from other countries too. Wherever you live, your child can learn with a dedicated teacher, in the language your family speaks at home.

🇬🇧 United Kingdom 🇫🇷 France 🇮🇹 Italy 🌍 And anywhere else

Classes are arranged to suit your country's time — ask on WhatsApp and we will find a time that works for your family.

Learn in your language

Classes are offered in these four languages — choose the one your family prefers.

Classes are taught in:

  • Bangla — বাংলা
  • English
  • Arabic — العربية
  • Hindi — हिन्दी

Tell us your preferred language when you book your free trial.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Straight answers, from what the institute shares on its Facebook page. Anything else — just ask on WhatsApp.

Yes. The institute offers a completely free trial class before admission, so you can experience a real lesson and meet the teacher before you enrol.

Yes. The institute teaches with experienced male and female teachers, and female teachers are available for women and girls. Mention your preference when you book.

Yes. There are courses for children and for adults, including complete beginners. Each student has their own dedicated teacher and learns at their own pace.

With Noorani Qaida — the beginner course that teaches the Arabic letters and reading from the very beginning. Tajweed is taught from the start, so correct recitation grows with you.
